newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud buys 75 pct of construction firm.
newsitem.headline: Exbud buys 75 pct of construction firm.

text.p: The Polish construction company Exbud SA paid the treasury ministry 2.9 million zlotys for a 75 percent stake in builder Gdanskie Przedsiebiorstwo Budownictwa Przemyslowego Przem-Bud Sp. z o.o, the ministry said.

It said in a statement on Wednesday that Exbud agreed to raise Przem-Bud's capital by a further 3.2 million zlotys and that the cash would be used to invest in the company's fixed assets. Exbud will also keep the firm's jobs for two years.
Out of the remaining 25 percent of Przem-Bud's shares, 20 percent is to be offered to employees within two months and the treasury will keep five percent for restitution claims. @
